reading.body:
Flexential Denver - Englewood publishes 18 MW of IT capacity across 240,549 square feet. Whether this supports 450 AI training racks or 1,800 colocation racks depends on power density, which the operator has not disclosed.

The facility holds seven distinct compliance certifications covering financial services, payment processing, export controls, federal security, and healthcare. This breadth of credentials makes it eligible for regulated workloads across multiple sectors, but the certifications indicate permission to serve these customers, not confirmation of who actually operates there. The operator publishes capacity but not tenant identity or utilization.

Among Colorado facilities mapped by this site, Englewood is first by disclosed capacity. That ranking reflects one facility's transparency, not necessarily Colorado's physical infrastructure scale. Only one of 17 mapped Colorado sites publishes a megawatt figure. Colorado's proximity to Rocky Mountain renewable generation is published fact, but this campus's actual power sources and grid interconnection points are not.
